## v1.0

- Initial Flipper Apps Catalog release of TommyBox Capture
- Added 10x10 application icon
- Continuous hands-free SLIX-L batch scanning with automatic TommyBox privacy unlock
- Strict 8/8 block integrity validation and SD card read-back verification
- Configurable Settings for existing incomplete captures (Keep by default, optional Rename or Delete)
- Built-in About / How to use guide, automatic UID deduplication, on-device renaming, and SD card auditor
